summary: Added release paths: rejectedPaths lists git files (cached and untracked, not ignored) from the top directory and checks each with module.CheckFilePath. Usage line, doc comment, README section, TestPaths, TestRepositoryPaths and golang.org/x/mod v0.37.0 as a direct requirement are in.
verified: vloop task gate T2 exited 0 and printed gate T2: ok; go test ./tools/release, go vet, gofmt -l and go mod tidy pass.
notes: rejectedPaths(dir) finds the top with git rev-parse --show-toplevel, then runs git -C top ls-files -z. The fixture tests build repos with the existing newRepo helper; no ' path is written into the tree.
